- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided details for the Low-Sugar Berry Bliss Smoothie Recipe (makes 5-6 servings):
  - Ingredients: 2 cups frozen mixed berries, 1 cup frozen pineapple, 1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk, 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt, 1/4 cup chia seeds, 1 tablespoon hemp seeds, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder (optional), 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract, ice cubes.
  - Instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth, adjust sweetness if needed, and store in containers.
